text:
**Short answer:** 30W is the minimum for a MacBook Air, and 70W or higher is what you want for fast charging.

**By model (per [Apple Support](https://support.apple.com/en-us/109509)):**
- **2022 or later:** Apple recommends a 30W (13-inch only), 35W dual-port, 67W, or 70W adapter with a USB-C to MagSafe 3 cable. These models can also charge over a regular USB-C cable.
- **2018 to 2021:** Apple recommends a 30W or 40W adapter with a USB-C cable.
- **Any USB-C Mac:** Any USB Power Delivery (USB PD) adapter will charge it, even at higher or lower wattage than Apple recommends. For the best experience, use at least the recommended wattage.

**Fast charging:** Apple's specs for the [M4](https://fd.xuwubk.eu.org/https/support.apple.com/en-us/122209) and [M5](https://fd.xuwubk.eu.org/https/support.apple.com/en-us/126320) 13-inch Air say fast charging needs a 70W or higher USB PD source. Apple's [M5 spec page](https://images.apple.com/tm/macbook-air/specs/) lists 30W as the minimum wattage to charge. The in-box adapter varies by model:
- The M4 comes with a 30W or 35W adapter, depending on GPU configuration.
- The M5 comes with a 40W Dynamic Power Adapter (60W max).

**If you want a third-party option:** The [Baseus GaN5 Pro 65W](https://dealectric.com/go/baseus-gan5-pro-65w-2c-u) (2 USB-C and 1 USB-A) is listed at $49.99 for a 2-pack, verified 2026-10-21, so check the price at checkout. Details from [the listing](https://dealectric.com/baseus-gan5-pro-65w-2c-u):
- It supports USB PD 3.0 and delivers 65W from a single USB-C port, which is plenty to charge a MacBook Air.
- Because it is under 70W, it likely won't qualify for Apple's fast charging.
- With two or more devices plugged in, the laptop port drops to 45W.
- That link is an affiliate link, so the site earns a commission if you buy through it.

For true fast charging, Apple's own [70W USB-C Power Adapter](https://support.apple.com/en-us/109509) is the safe pick, though I don't have a current price for it. Tell me which year and size your Air is, and I can narrow this down.
